decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=/net/uplink/b<pair 3:1>, kind=RESULT, payload=VALUE u32=1234 } - the same relay when the hop can issue no PAIR for the link the reply came back on (its connection vertex retired under it): src grows by the hop's NAME run instead, so the chain is a full route, mixed, never one hop short (RFC-0029 6.2).
decoded.note: NAME-fallback arm of fwd/reply-src-accumulates-forward-route-pair; the two differ only in the hop's element.
